title: Data of a logs event (TELEMETRY.md section 3)
description: One new entry of the audit ring, sent when it is recorded (an event stream: no period). Names, never codes. A repeat of an earlier entry is folded in the ring and sent again with its running count. The entry holds no secret, password or command argument. At most 5 events a second; dropped counts the entries not sent since the previous event.

ts.description: Unix seconds when the entry was recorded; null while the device clock was not set

what.description: the command class refused, or the new posture or connectivity mode (posture: normal or hardened; mode: ble or wifi)
